known_errors.title: Payment API TLS Handshake Failure
known_errors.description: TLS negotiation fails when a cert is within 7 days of expiry on payment-api. Root cause: misconfigured OCSP stapling on the load balancer.
known_errors.workaround: Manually force cert rotation via the certificate pipeline (RFC fast-track). OCSP stapling must be toggled off and back on post-rotation.
known_errors.permanent_fix: RFC-9812 or equivalent — update load balancer OCSP config to version 3.2.

known_errors.title: Notification Service DB Connection Pool Exhaustion
known_errors.description: Under high load (>2000 req/min) the notification-service exhausts its Postgres connection pool. Manifests as 500 errors and cascading timeouts into payment-api.
known_errors.workaround: Restart the notification-service pod (kubectl rollout restart). Reduces load within 60 seconds.
known_errors.permanent_fix: Increase PgBouncer pool size from 20 to 50 and enable pgpool-II (requires CAB approval).

known_errors.title: Fraud Check Service Stale CMDB Edges
known_errors.description: CMDB edges for fraud-check (svc-017) have not been verified since Feb 2026. Any automated tooling relying on CMDB for fraud-check will refuse to act.
known_errors.workaround: Submit a CMDB refresh request to the platform team (Service Request SR category). Expected SLA: 2 business days.
known_errors.permanent_fix: Automate CMDB edge verification via discovery tool (Project ID: DISC-2026-04).

known_errors.title: Marketing Site 502 During Deployments
known_errors.description: marketing-site (svc-055) returns 502 for ~30 seconds during rolling deployments due to a missing readiness probe.
known_errors.workaround: Disable the CDN cache for marketing-site 5 minutes before any deployment. Re-enable after health checks pass.
known_errors.permanent_fix: Add a proper Kubernetes readiness probe (PR already merged, pending release train).
